title: "![](/assets/node-icons/Terminal.svg){height=20} Terminal"
---

A Terminal is a water sink without state or properties.
Any water that flows into a Terminal node is removed from the model.
No water can come into the model from a Terminal node.
For example, Terminal nodes can be used as a downstream boundary.

# Allowed connectivity

The diagram below shows which node types are allowed directly upstream (left) and downstream (right) of this node.
This is a connectivity illustration, not a valid simulation model.

```{python}
# | code-fold: true
%run ../../../utils/plot_node_connectivity.py
fig = plot_node_connectivity("Terminal")
plt.show()
plt.close(fig)
```

# Tables

No tables are required for Terminal nodes.

# Equations

The incoming node determines the flow into the Terminal node.
